what_happened.line: The Town Manager Screening Committee took no recorded votes and set two more meetings, Aug 19 and Aug 27, to review procurement progress and results.
The committee interviewed Community Paradigm Associates, a recruiting firm, about its search process and timeline.
The chair reported that a recruiting firm must be procured through three bids because of the dollar amount, with a solicitation to be prepared in about two weeks.
The committee was told the procurement officer signs the contract, and that the lowest bidder must be accepted or all bids rejected.
A resident objected during public comment to spending on a recruiting firm.

why_it_matters: Who the town hires to run the town manager search, and at what price, is set by a three-bid procurement rule, so the lowest compliant bid decides the outcome unless every bid is rejected.
The spending on the search firm is a cost residents may be asked about, and the committee has not yet put a cost to a vote.
